biography: Willian Cancelier, born in the heart of São Paulo, practically grew up on racing fuel. His father, a mechanic for a local karting team, instilled a love for speed and competition from a young age. Willian's first taste of racing came at age 10, piloting a beat-up kart his father pieced together from spare parts. A defining moment arrived at the regional karting championship in 2010, where, despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, Willian spectacularly carved his way through the field to snatch victory on the final corner, a move that earned him the nickname 'The Cyclone'. From karting, he transitioned to Formula Dirt, the Brazilian off-road racing series. Currently, Willian is considered a top contender in the Formula Dirt series, driving for the Formula Dirt team, consistently battling for podium finishes and aiming for the championship title. A recent engine failure during the Amazon GP was a setback, but the team is working hard to get him back on track. He is known for his aggressive driving style and flamboyant personality, both on and off the track.
drivingStyle: Cancelier's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos'. He's known for his late braking and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the limits of grip to gain an advantage. While this approach can sometimes lead to spectacular overtakes, it also carries the risk of overdriving and making mistakes. He's still developing his tire management skills, often sacrificing early pace for a late-race charge. Under pressure, Cancelier tends to become even more aggressive, which can either result in a brilliant victory or a costly error.

careerHighlight: Winning the 2020 Minas Gerais Grand Prix in dominant fashion, leading from start to finish and setting a new track record, marking his breakthrough moment in Formula Dirt.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2022 Amazon GP due to a mechanical failure, costing him a crucial victory and severely impacting his championship hopes.
